about_the_game:
"Doesn't being inside an elevator feel cut off from the rest of the world?

 What if the doors opened, and it was a different world entirely?"

About This Game:

Kagesumi: Deliverance blends a 3D first-person "Short Walking Simulator" with "Elevator Horror." You play as a rookie delivery person, tasked with bringing packages to the eerie Kagesumi Manor, a building steeped in bizarre rumors.

The elevator in this apartment building sometimes connects to unexpected places—the "Otherworld."

This is a dangerous realm where common sense doesn't apply. If you see something out of the ordinary, that's a sign you've arrived. Once you "realize" the abnormality, don't delve deeper. Immediately return to the elevator and try for your intended floor again.

Estimated Playtime

15 - 60 minutes

Features

  • Travel Between Reality and the Otherworld via Elevator: Your deliveries are obstructed by various "Otherworlds" you stumble into via the elevator. Physics bend, impossible sights unfold, and sometimes, unidentifiable "somethings" lurk. The longer you stay in the Otherworld, the more it consumes you.

  • The Mundane and Extraordinary Life of a Delivery Person: Your job is to deliver packages to the residents. However, the items have unsettling names, and the destinations can be peculiar. As you continue your deliveries, the strangeness of the manor intensifies.

  • The Manor's Strange Rules: You must obey the rules posted in the entrance. "Residents have priority," "Do not go to floors you have no business on," "Do not speak to the residents"... Fail to follow these rules, and the threats of the Otherworld will draw closer.

  • Exploration and Realization: Paying close attention to changes in your surroundings and recognizing "this is the Otherworld" is crucial. Escaping requires quick thinking and action. Sometimes, however, you might have to venture deeper into the Otherworld...?

  • Hidden Truths: Simply completing deliveries won't reveal the true nature of this manor. Careful exploration, deciphering the meaning behind the rules, and listening to certain voices might open a path to a different ending.

Will you successfully deliver all the packages and escape this bizarre manor? Or will you become trapped in the Otherworld, forever a part of it?
